name: Turbo0
conditions: Free plan requires a backlink to turbo0.com on your site
Free submissions are 'reviewed and listed within 2 weeks'
An account is required — /submit renders a login/signup form (email, Google, or GitHub)

sources.title: Turbo0 pricing — Free/Basic/Pro/Review Blog plans and backlink requirements
Turbo0 submit page — redirects to login/signup
Turbo0 homepage — content-creator tools directory with collections

requirements: Product aimed at content creators — Turbo0's positioning is 'a curated hub of efficient tools and resources for content creators' (video/audio editing, image, copywriting, website creation, note-taking, management, growth)
Backlink to turbo0.com required on the free plan
Working product with a live URL
preparation: A place on your site to host the required backlink for the free plan

Decide free vs paid: Basic $29.9 (was $49.9) one-time — backlink optional, listed immediately, 3 customizable dofollow links; Pro $99.9 (was $149.9) — 5+1 dofollow links, featured border, priority support
workflow: Create an account and open https://turbo0.com/submit
Complete the submission form and choose the plan
For free: add the turbo0.com backlink to your site
Wait for review (advertised as within 2 weeks for free listings)
Confirm the listing renders publicly on turbo0.com
watchFor: FAQ on the pricing page includes 'Why wasn't my tool listed?' — rejections happen; content-creator fit matters
Paid plans are one-time payments, not subscriptions (struck-through prices suggest a standing sale)
Review Blog upsell ($199–249) is a separate editorial product, not a listing
Free plan FAQ notes listings may be unlisted; keep the backlink in place
countsAsLive: A public product detail page on turbo0.com linked from category/collection pages with a 'Visit Website' outbound link
unknowns: Exact form fields behind the login gate
Whether the free-plan backlink is re-verified and what triggers delisting
Current real wait time for the free queue
